name: Automated SaaS Onboarding & Obsidian Vault Logging
description: Automates account registration across target SaaS services, verifies email sign-ups, and logs credentials & API keys to Obsidian Vault.

workflow.description: Fleet Orchestrator initializes SaaS Onboarding playbook.
Sign-Up Agent completes registration form, types passwords, and verifies email.
Obsidian Agent writes login credentials and API keys to Credentials.md inside Obsidian Vault.
